title: Dutch Land Inside Belgium Inside the Netherlands
description:
The Netherlands, inside Belgium, inside the Netherlands. Baarle's geography is real: 22 Belgian enclaves, seven nested Dutch enclaves, and one more Dutch enclave on the Belgian mainland.

Some borders even run through homes.

Somehow True: facts that sound made up, checked before we tell them.

Sources:
Baarle-Hertog municipality: https://www.baarle-hertog.be/30-enclaves
Deutsche Welle: https://www.dw.com/en/baarle-the-town-where-borders-run-riot/a-57631603
Visit Baarle: https://m-en.visitbaarle.com/locaties/enclaves-5e43f39e38374665355357fe

Visuals are AI-generated illustrations. Narration is synthetic. Music is original computer-generated.

#Shorts #Geography #SomehowTrue
script: There's Dutch land inside Belgian land inside the Netherlands. This is Baarle, where two countries form a puzzle of thirty enclaves. Twenty-two patches of Belgium are completely surrounded by Dutch territory. Inside the two largest Belgian patches sit seven Dutch enclaves. That's the Netherlands, inside Belgium, inside the Netherlands. One more Dutch enclave lies on the Belgian mainland. Twenty-two, plus seven, plus one. Thirty enclaves. And these borders don't politely stop at the edge of a building. They run through buildings, including people's homes. Imagine living in a house where the international border is inside your home.
